messages.author: b2d6c2a83fd21a45
messages.subject: Index.php Throws Error
parts:
Hi All,

I am using a MacBook with OSX 10.6.8

I have configured RApache and have R scripts running successfully;
however, when I try to load the index.php page, I receive a 500
Internal Server Error. I have the following in my httpd.conf file
(not the only lines, but just what I've changed is shown):

#Add PHP Handler
AddHandler application/x-httpd-php .php

<Directory />
SetHandler r-script
RHandler sys.source
</Directory>

#Point to Brew code - can't get this to work...
#<Directory /brew>
# SetHandler r-script
# RHandler brew::brew
#</Directory>

<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>

ROutputErrors


I checked my error_log and found

2: parse(n = -1, file = file)
1: sys.source(file = "/Users/mycomputer/Sites/index.php", envir
= .rAenv)
[Mon Mar 12 06:41:27 2012] [error] [client 10.0.1.2] rApache Notice!,
referer: http://10.0.1.2/~mycomputer/$
Error in parse(n = -1, file = file) : 1:1: unexpected '<'
1: <
^

I am an Apache Noob, so all help that is clearly explained is much
appreciated.

Thanks in advance for the help.

messages.author: b2d6c2a83fd21a45
messages.subject: Re: Index.php Throws Error
parts:
Hi All,

I used the following as my solution. I added this to httpd.conf:


<FilesMatch \.R$>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler sys.source
</FilesMatch>

Would love to get feedback from the community.

Thanks in advance.
